name: Bank Transfer (BACS) through Stripe
author: Pluginable

sections.description:
This WooCommerce plugin seamlessly integrates with Stripe to offer bank transfers manually as a payment option, generating a unique virtual bank account for each purchase, where customers can transfer funds via online banking or at their local branch; after the deposit clears, the order status automatically updates from ‘on-hold’ to ‘processing,’ providing an efficient, user-friendly transaction experience for both merchants and customers.

Key Features:
– Secure Money Transfer
– Virtual Bank Account Number
– Customer can transfer through their online banking interface
– Transfer In-person Bank Branch Option
– Protection of Real Account Details
– Automatically change order status to ‘processing’ once payment is cleared

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository or from the Pluginable.dev website.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  5. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  6. Once activated, configure the plugin by navigating to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and selecting Stripe (BACS) Bank Transfer Payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support test mode for Stripe?

Yes, the plugin includes a test mode option that allows you to process test transactions using Stripe’s test environment before going live.

Can I use this plugin alongside other Stripe gateways?

Absolutely. This plugin works independently of the default WooCommerce Stripe Gateway and can be enabled or disabled without conflict.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Currently, the plugin does not support recurring payments or WooCommerce Subscriptions. However, we are considering it for future updates.

Where can I configure the plugin settings?

Go to WordPress Dashboard → WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → “Stripe (BACS) Bank Transfer Payments” to configure your plugin settings, including live and test credentials.

How do I update the plugin?

You can update the plugin automatically through your WordPress dashboard or manually by uploading the latest version via FTP or the plugin installer.

Can I customize the payment method title or description?

Yes, you can customize the title and description shown on the checkout page directly from the WooCommerce settings — no coding or manual file editing needed.
